title: A Two-step Metropolis Hastings Method for Bayesian Empirical Likelihood Computation with Application to Quantile Regression and Bayesian Model Selection
abstract: arXiv:2209.01269v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Empirical likelihood-based methods have been used under the Bayesian framework (BayesEL) in recent times. For statistical inference, these methods require efficient Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) samplers for drawing observations from the parameter posterior distributions. However, the complex, especially non-convex, nature of the empirical likelihood support makes such MCMC algorithms harder to design.   Such difficulties have restricted the use of BayesEL methods in many applications. In this article, we propose a two-step Metropolis-Hastings algorithm to sample from the BayesEL posteriors. Our proposal uses the current values of suitable subsets of the parameters and the estimating equations determining the underlying empirical likelihood to propose values of the remaining parameters. translated_title: 一种用于贝叶斯经验似然计算的两步Metropolis Hastings方法及其在分位数回归和贝叶斯模型选择中的应用
translated_abstract: 基于经验似然的方法近年来已在贝叶斯框架下（BayesEL）被使用。对于统计推断，这些方法需要高效的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）采样器来从参数后验分布中抽取观测值。然而，经验似然支持域的复杂性，尤其是非凸性，使得设计此类MCMC算法变得更加困难。这些困难限制了BayesEL方法在许多应用中的使用。在本文中，我们提出了一种两步Metropolis-Hastings算法，用于从BayesEL后验分布中采样。我们的提议利用参数子集的当前值和确定底层经验似然的估计方程，来提议剩余参数的值。因此，所提出的方法适用于在许多复杂问题中从BayesEL后验分布采样，尤其是那些具有不连续性的问题。
tldr: 本文提出了一种两步Metropolis-Hastings算法，通过利用参数子集和估计方程来高效采样贝叶斯经验似然后验分布，解决了非凸支持域带来的采样难题，适用于分位数回归和贝叶斯模型选择等复杂问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-step Metropolis-Hastings algorithm that efficiently samples from Bayesian empirical likelihood posteriors by leveraging parameter subsets and estimating equations, addressing sampling challenges from non-convex support, and is applicable to quantile regression and Bayesian model selection.
